capabilities: Navigate to a note's parent page via a hotkey-bound command
Define parent links with an "up" property in frontmatter
Pick one target when the up property lists multiple parents
Open the parent in a new tab or reuse an existing tab
Customize which frontmatter property names the parent
extras: README includes a suggested hotkey (Cmd + Shift + U) and documents tab-pinning behavior in detail.
problem: Obsidian links are typically bidirectional, but notes often need an explicit one-way "parent" link that can be navigated with a single keystroke.
summary: Navigation plugin that jumps to a note's designated parent page, defined by an "up" property in the note's frontmatter.
